ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High; predominantly high-intensity white central surface (estimated 80-85%) framed by low-intensity black marginal boundaries and focal dark pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous low-intensity black perimeter along the trailing edge and tips; distinct black focal circular blobs in the upper right quadrant of the right lobe; vertical black linear streak extending from the median notch toward the peduncle; scattered micro-speckling on the left lobe's leading edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; interior angle approximately 65 degrees; vertical notch depth is roughly 12% of the total visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous micro-serration along the trailing boundary; higher frequency and pixel-amplitude variations concentrated at the distal lobe tips where topography becomes irregular.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve along the trailing edges of both lobes originating from the notch and extending to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density, high-texture clusters of light-colored circular formations (barnacles) at both distal tips; distinct dark circular 'ring' scars visible in the upper mid-section of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned linear pixel disruptions; prominent diagonal scratch on the lower right lobe; vertical rake-like markings on the upper central region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the lateral extremities; prominent dark vertical streak at the median junction; various dark linear and circular scars distributed across the white ventral field.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark 'drip' shaped marking located near the leading edge of the left lobe.
